parrafo_1.es: Blue Diamond PetSpaw es un salón de grooming en Port St. Lucie donde cada perro recibe atención individual: baño, corte, uñas y el estilo que su dueño pida, desde clásico hasta creativo.
parrafo_1.en: Blue Diamond PetSpaw is a grooming salon in Port St. Lucie where every dog gets individual attention: bath, haircut, nails and whatever style the owner asks for, from classic to creative.

parrafo_2.es: Varios clientes llevan a sus mascotas aquí desde hace más de una década. Destacan lo fácil que es conseguir cita y lo atento que es el equipo en cada visita.
parrafo_2.en: Several clients have brought their pets here for over a decade. They point to how easy it is to get an appointment and how attentive the team is on every visit.

items.quote: They do an amazing job with my dog here! We like her hair short because of the hot weather. They make it easy to get an appointment and she comes home smelling great every time.
I'm always thrilled with the grooming service here! The staff is friendly and attentive, making my dogs feel right at home every time. They do an excellent job.
My older Shorkie Sailor has been going to this location for over 10 years and HarborRose, the younger one, for three years. There have been a few different owners but the care has stayed consistent.
